content: अविवेक {%a.%} Wanting in judgment or discrimination, thoughtless. .{@-कः@} .²1 Want of discrimination or judgment, absence of prudence, imprudence; अविवेकः परमापदां पदम् <ls>Ki. 2. 30</ls>. .²2 Hastiness, rashness, recklessness. .²3 Ignorance; (अन्योन्यतादात्म्यरूपमिथ्याज्ञानम्). .²4 Non-separation, non-distinction; पौरुषं कर्म दैवं च कालवृत्तिस्वभावतः . त्रयमेतत्पृथग्भूतमविवेकं तु केचन .. <ls>Mb. 12. 238. 5</ls>.
